title: Anthropic turns Claude into a full workspace with Plugins, spreadsheets, whiteboards, and soon Meeting notes
original_title: Anthropic turns Claude into a full workspace with Plugins, spreadsheets, whiteboards, and soon Meeting notes
summary: Anthropic is expanding Claude with Sheets, Whiteboards, and Interactive Connectors, letting partners like Adobe and Atlassian embed their apps directly inside Claude. Anthropic says Claude Meetings,…
title_zh: Claude 加入表格、白板和应用连接
lead_zh: 报道称，Claude 新增表格、白板和数据看板，并让设计、协作和客户管理三类伙伴把应用嵌进来。公司说会议记录功能即将推出。
